facts.fact: Togo's Council of Ministers examined and adopted, on 20 October 2017, a decree approving the digital-economy sector policy declaration for 2018-2022, reported by Togo-Presse.
facts.system: déclaration de politique du secteur de l'économie numérique 2018-2022

facts.fact: The adopted digital-economy sector policy declaration covers the period 2018-2022, replacing the 2011-2015 sector declaration that had expired.
facts.system: déclaration de politique du secteur de l'économie numérique 2018-2022

facts.fact: The policy provides a steering and monitoring set-up: a national digital committee under the Prime Minister and a technical committee for operational steering led by the minister in charge of the digital economy, with the ministry of posts and digital economy to strengthen its action.
